title: oncall: runbook & diagnostics enhancements for SLO toolkit integration
author: Alexandra Kim
description: Motivation: improve on-call workflows by surfacing SLO-linked runbooks and richer automated diagnostics from the SLO toolkit directly in incident-bot. This PR wires SLO -> runbook links into the oncall UI and enriches diagnostics payloads with timeline snippets and recent related alerts. What this change does: adds a lightweight runbook link resolver (backed by SLO metadata), returns compact diagnostic summaries with recent alert hashes and top-3 correlated traces, and exposes a new oncall helper endpoint for fetching runbook+diag bundles. Also adds telemetry for runbook link clicks. Checklist: - [x] add runbook resolver and caching layer - [x] augment diagnostics payload with alert/trace summary - [x] add endpoint /oncall/runbook-diagnostics (internal) - [x] unit + integration tests for resolver and endpoint - [x] small console UI tweak to display links (frontend PR forthcoming) Notes: this is backwards-compatible for existing incident-bot consumers; the new endpoint is gated by an internal feature flag. Related Linear tasks: ENG-4012, SRE-219. Addresses SLO regressions flagged during incident INC-2026 (follow-up).

release_notes: Expose runbook + diagnostics bundles for oncall workflows (internal feature flag). Adds runbook resolver with caching, diagnostics payload enrichment with recent alerts and correlated traces, and telemetry for runbook clicks. Backwards-compatible; requires frontend console update to render links.
notes_for_ops: Feature is behind feature flag 'oncall_runbook_diag'. Rollout plan: enable for 10% of oncall teams for 48h, monitor telemetry and SLO alert counts. Telemetry events: runbook_click, runbook_diag_fetch. If increased error rate observed, disable flag and roll back within 30m.
security_considerations: Runbook links are read-only; resolver sanitizes input and only resolves runbooks referenced by SLO metadata or whitelisted tags. Diagnostics payload omits full trace payloads - returns trace ids and compact summaries only.
